patch:
Index: Dockerfile
===================================================================
--- Dockerfile	
+++ Dockerfile	
@@ -0,0 +1,22 @@
+FROM node:22-alpine
+
+WORKDIR /app
+
+# Install pnpm
+RUN npm install -g pnpm
+
+# Copy dependency files
+COPY package.json pnpm-lock.yaml ./
+
+# Install dependencies
+RUN pnpm install
+
+# Copy source
+COPY . .
+
+EXPOSE 8443
+
+ENV PORT=8443
+ENV HOST=0.0.0.0
+
+CMD ["pnpm", "dev"]
\ No newline at end of file

Index: docker-compose.yml
===================================================================
--- docker-compose.yml	
+++ docker-compose.yml	
@@ -0,0 +1,13 @@
+services:
+  app:
+    build:
+      context: .
+      dockerfile: Dockerfile
+    ports:
+      - "8443:8443"
+    environment:
+      - PORT=8443
+      - HOST=0.0.0.0
+    volumes:
+      - .:/app
+      - /app/node_modules
